DETERMINATION

Meridian Health Plan has completed review of the inpatient admission identified above and has issued an adverse determination based on medical necessity. Payment for the inpatient level of care billed under DRG 291 for the period [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]] is denied.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODES

CARC CO-50
RARC N115

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION

Review was conducted against the InterQual-style criteria set applicable to this admission. The submitted clinical documentation was evaluated by a physician reviewer. Based on that review, the services provided could have been delivered safely at a lower level of care, such as observation.

The following criteria were not met:

CHF-02: Diuresis was achieved with a single intravenous dose and could have been managed with oral medication.

CHF-04: Renal function was at baseline and did not require inpatient monitoring.

No other criteria codes were applied in reaching this adverse determination on medical necessity. This notice addresses the medical necessity of the inpatient level of care only.

APPEAL RIGHTS

The member, or a provider acting as the member's authorized representative, may request a Level 1 appeal of this adverse determination. A Level 1 appeal must be submitted by letter or by portal upload. The appeal submission should cite the criteria codes CHF-02 and CHF-04 inline and should address the findings stated above for each code. Please attach the History and Physical and all progress notes for the admission. Appeal submissions are limited to five pages, exclusive of attached medical records.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Requests received after that deadline may be closed without substantive review.

The determination described in this notice is limited to coverage and payment for the inpatient admission reviewed. It is not a determination regarding the care rendered by the treating provider, and it does not direct the course of treatment.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Meridian Health Plan
